purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Bhabua

queries.query: Bhabua Bihar official cadastral map parcel GIS land records
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Bihar BhuNaksha, the Directorate of Land Records and Survey, the Revenue and Land Reforms Department, and the official Kaimur district land-records page. BhuNaksha exposes a public cadastral viewer and hierarchical Kaimur/Bhabua selections, but the selected Bhabua municipal map extent request returned HTTP 204 and no parcel geometry was obtained.

queries.query: भभुआ बिहार आधिकारिक कैडस्ट्रल नक्शा भू अभिलेख कैमूर भभुआ
queries.result: Hindi first-party discovery confirmed the Kaimur district land-records route, BhuNaksha revenue-map service, and local Bhभुआ administrative context. No safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was found.

registryEvidence.custodian: Directorate of Land Records and Survey / Revenue and Land Reforms Department, Government of Bihar; the official Kaimur district page identifies the local land-records office in Bhabua.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: BhuNaksha is a first-party Bihar cadastral-map service and its hierarchy exposed Kaimur (Bhabua), Bhabua subdivision, Bhabua circle, and a Bhabua municipal ward mauza. This establishes a local/state cadastral custodian, not open parcel-vector qualification or runtime admission.

boundedResponse.result: No usable parcel geometry response; selected map extent and plot-at-coordinate requests returned HTTP 204.

parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted. No exact-point miss was treated as citywide absence.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Same-origin REST/WMS routes were observed in the official BhuNaksha JavaScript; no successful map response exposed a layer schema.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: Hierarchy provenance observed as Bihar state 10 / Kaimur district 31 / Bhabua subdivision 01 / Bhabua circle 03 / municipal ward mauza 0425. This is source location hierarchy, not a parcel identity.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: Public hierarchy and map endpoints only; no login, CAPTCHA bypass, credentials, private token, owner, address, titleholder, tax, or account fields requested.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity if publicly exposed and source-proven

qualification.reason: A local/state cadastral custodian and public viewer hierarchy are evidenced, but no source-native parcel identity, geometry, schema, or CRS was qualified.

scopeLimits: HTTP 204, map extent miss, unusable UI, timeout, login wall, or zero exact-point hit is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

uncertainty: BhuNaksha may contain parcel maps for other Bhabua mauzas or map instances; current bounded anonymous requests did not establish coverage, native parcel identity semantics, CRS, or usable geometry for this city packet.
